controls.primaryButton: Post, Reply and Save, the sign-in card’s Sign in, the report dialog’s submit, and a moderator’s main decision (Approve or Keep)
controls.secondaryButton: Cancel, Show comments, Load more comments and replies, Try again, Follow, the sign-in card’s Comment as a guest and Follow by email, Review in Comments, adding files to an Assets field, and a moderator’s other decisions

controls.input: Guest name and email, and text, email, number, URL and date custom fields
controls.textarea: The plain comment box, the report dialog’s details and multi-line custom fields. Rich mode’s editor follows the CSS custom properties instead
controls.checkbox: The reply-email opt-in, and checkbox and lightswitch custom fields
controls.radio: The report reasons and radio custom fields
controls.link: The link around each comment’s date, which is its permalink. Links inside a comment’s text are reached with `.comments__content a` instead
controls.avatar: Every avatar, on comments and beside the editor

header.draws: The heading with the count, the sort options, Follow and a moderator’s summary of held and reported comments

empty.draws: What a thread with no comments says

showButton.draws: The **Show comments** button for the `button` load mode

loading.draws: The loading line while the thread’s data is on its way

notice.draws: Why nobody can post, such as a closed thread’s notice

comment.context: `comment`, `permissions`, `viewer`, `conversation`, `actions`, and `form()` and `replies()`, which the override must draw

badge.draws: One of the author’s badges, once for each

meta.draws: The date and permalink, inline custom fields and the edited note

fields.draws: The custom fields shown under the text, as a labelled list
fields.context: `fields`, the comment’s entries shown under its text, with the comment’s context

review.draws: A moderator’s review box on a held or reported comment
review.context: `moderation`, the comment’s moderation details, with the comment’s context

placeholder.draws: What stands in for a comment that’s no longer shown but still has replies

join.draws: The sign-in card a guest sees in place of the comment box

postingAs.draws: “Posting as” and the member’s badges, above a member’s comment box

formFields.draws: The custom fields the form asks for, once for those above the text and once for those below it
formFields.context: `fields`, the descriptions of the fields in this group, and `position`, `above` or `below`

errors.validation_failed: Something posted didn’t pass validation, such as an empty comment or a required field left out. `fieldErrors` says which.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: An upload’s type isn’t allowed, or its contents don’t match its extension.
errors.file_too_large: An upload is larger than the field or the server allows.
errors.too_many_files: More files than a field takes, or a guest’s address has too many uploads waiting to be posted.
errors.protection_required: A write arrived without the spam protection evidence it needs, or with a preparation that isn’t valid.
errors.protection_expired: The protection preparation ran out or was already used. Core fetches a new one and tries once more by itself.
errors.protection_unavailable: The spam protection service couldn’t be reached. Trying again later can work.
errors.challenge_failed: The visitor didn’t pass a challenge, such as Turnstile’s. Never retried automatically.
errors.possible_spam: Protect judged the comment to be spam. Never retried automatically.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests from one address. `retryAfter` says how many seconds to wait.
errors.sign_in_required: The action needs a signed-in member, or a request on another site came without a member token.
errors.token_expired: A member token ran out. `memberToken()` fetches the next one and tries once more.
errors.token_revoked: A member token was revoked or isn’t known, or its member changed their password since it was minted.
errors.session_expired: A guest’s session token ran out, changed or moved. The sign-in provider starts a new session and tries once more.
errors.origin_not_allowed: The request’s origin doesn’t fit its profile, or isn’t listed in **Other Sites** with what it needs.
errors.csrf_failed: A cookie sign-in’s write came without a valid CSRF token. `cookieSession()` reads a new token and tries once more.
errors.signature_invalid: A signed `member-token` or `revoke-member-tokens` request from a site’s own server has a missing, wrong, old or repeated signature.
errors.user_not_eligible: A `member-token` request named a user who can’t have one, such as a suspended or unknown user.
errors.forbidden: The person can’t do this to this comment, such as voting where voting is off or editing someone else’s comment.
errors.blocked: The person is blocked from taking part.
errors.closed: The thread is closed to new comments.
errors.edit_window_passed: The comment can no longer be edited or deleted by its author.
errors.not_found: The owner, comment or thread doesn’t exist or isn’t public, or has comments turned off.
errors.conflict: The comment changed since it was loaded. Load it again before saving.
errors.limit_exceeded: A request asked for too many items at once.
errors.invalid_cursor: A page’s cursor isn’t valid any more, such as after the sort or limit changed. Load the thread again.
errors.method_not_allowed: The action was called with the wrong HTTP method.
errors.unsupported_api_version: The server and the package read different versions of the JSON format, usually a page left open across an upgrade. Reloading fixes it.
errors.server_error: The server failed, or answered with an error page rather than the data API’s JSON.
errors.network_error: The request never reached the server, or was abandoned after the timeout.
errors.invalid_response: The answer wasn’t the data API’s JSON, such as a proxy’s page or a body without `apiVersion`.
errors.invalid_request: The request couldn’t be read, such as a body that isn’t a JSON object or a profile the API doesn’t know.
